description: Na₃Zr₂Si₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.74 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.23 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-44°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-41°. There are two shorter (1.65 Å) and two longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-39°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond length. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one P atom.
